brief: Three strongest caption-led Swinging Door cartoons, selected after canon, staging, and factual-premise review.
writer: Codex caption audit of the existing writers-room batch

panels.speaker: barclay
panels.caption: My kids don't want the house, Drew, they want the three-percent mortgage.
panels.action: Barclay raises his old fashioned an inch; Drew turns toward him with his martini resting on its coaster.
panels.tv: FEW HOMES FOR SALE AS OWNERS STAY PUT
panels.tvPicture: a moving truck parked at a curb with its rear doors shut
panels.turn: category theft — the loan becomes the family heirloom

panels.speaker: barclay
panels.caption: I've never paid full price for anything. I just pay the renewal.
panels.action: Barclay holds his old fashioned in both hands, content; Drew turns toward him beside his untouched martini.
panels.tv: PROMOTIONAL RATES END FOR MILLIONS OF CUSTOMERS
panels.tvPicture: a curbside mailbox stuffed with plain envelopes
panels.board: OLD FASHIONED, FIRST YEAR $9 · YEAR FOUR $16
panels.turn: contradiction — never full price, always the renewal

panels.speaker: barclay
panels.caption: I don't mind tipping twenty percent on a coffee. I'd just like the coffee first.
panels.action: Abby smiles while sliding Barclay's old fashioned the final inch; Barclay waits with folded hands and Drew lifts his martini.
panels.tvPicture: an empty coffee cup beside a tablet on a stand
panels.turn: cheerful concession — the tip is granted and the coffee requested
